newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - June 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - June 25.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- U.S. official says Iraq deputy premier behind hiding of weapons of mass destruction.
- Iran arrests a U.S. national for trying to enter the country illegally.
- Saudi industry minister permits the setting up of a $41 million water plant in Jeddah.
- A $33 million cable television company is set up in Kuwait.
- A Saudi national accused of involvement in the Khobar bomb blast in which 19 Americans were killed last year to stand trial on Wednesday in Washington.
- Jordan's King Hussein, Qatar's emir discuss in London the Middle East peace process and Doha's hosting of economic summit.
- A $300 million Islamic investment fund for rental financing to be set up in Lebanon.
- Jordanian firms sign $68 million contracts with Iraq under Baghdad's food-for-oil deal.
